notes:
Background: Pegasus Loop builds analytics and in-product recommendations for B2B SaaS apps. Recently added a contextual help/chat feature; current vendor costs are spiking with growth. They started with Redwood hosted API evaluation (Q4 2025) and liked latency and dev ergonomics.

Decision drivers: mid-market cost pressure + need for predictable throughput for customer-facing chat, strict data residency for EU customers, and full auditability. Wants same API across hosted->dedicated so product team doesn't change code.

Technical priorities (from SE calls):
- P95 latency target: <=220ms for short chat prompts (system+user ~ 150-300 token).
- Throughput target: sustained 80–120 reqs/s during peak, burst to 250 for batch exports.
- Model strategy: prefer open 7B/13B variants quantized for cost; want fallback to smaller quantized 3B for overload.
- Routing: canary rollout on 5% traffic to Dedicated pool then ramp; automatic fallback to hosted_api or smaller variant when Dedicated capacity degraded.
- Region failover: primary us-east, secondary us-west, EU residency for GDPR customers (eu-west route).
- Rollback plan: instant abort on error spike (>2% 5xx) and automatic revert to previous model variant + alert to SRE/AE.

Quote: "If we can get a predictable p95 and a clear cost delta vs hosted, we can greenlight Dedicated for Q2 pilot." — Head of Product (A. Martinez).

Procurement/security: security asked for SOC2 Type II report, KMS integration details, and an example audit log. We provided Redwood security FAQ and pricing deck (drive links above). Network wants a 2-week window to stand up VPC peering and test TLS routing.

POC scope proposed: 4 weeks. Week 0: infra + meet security. Week 1: deploy Dedicated baseline (13B quant). Week 2: run canary (5% traffic) + trace collection. Week 3: scale to 30% + cost analysis + run fallback scenarios (region failover + model variant fallback). Acceptance criteria: stable p95 < 250ms, successful automated fallbacks in 3/3 tests, cost per 1k tokens within projected range.

Links: pricing deck, security FAQ, Fireflies demos attached.

AE notes: follow up with legal on draft SOW; prioritise a short runbook for canary->fallback->rollback steps to share with customer's SRE team.
